responsibility: This implementation module implements the Logitech-compatible floating-point utility layer for GNU Modula-2. It provides direct arithmetic helpers for REAL and LONGREAL values, including fractional-part extraction, truncation toward zero, nearest-integer rounding, and conversions from INTEGER to floating types, using built-in numeric conversions rather than formatted string paths.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the FloatingUtilities pair: it computes the declared fractional-part, rounding, truncation, and conversion helpers directly with arithmetic and VAL/TRUNC, whereas FloatingUtilities.def only declares those routines.
